title: Sunday Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A classic French-inspired Moroccan dish, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. Chicken cooked in a flavorful tagine with aromatic spices and herbs.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken thighs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine and transfer to the oven. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
